title: Promising Fisetin Benefits: From Anti-Aging to Heart and Kidney Health | The Healthy RD
abstract:
### Fisetin for Healthy Aging  
The [anti-aging effects](https://www.thelancet.com/article/S2352-3964%2818%2930373-6/fulltext) of fisetin are multifaceted. By acting like a housecleaner, fisetin clears “zombie” cells ([senescent cells](https://www.cellsignal.com/science-resources/overview-of-cellular-senescence)) which reduces their burden of these cells on our organs and tissues. Senescent cells cause increased levels of oxidative stress and abnormal [mitochondria](https://thehealthyrd.com/mitochondria-diet-tips-for-energy/). These zombie cells can cause inflammation and damage healthy cells. Research shows that fisetin clears these unhealthy cells out of kidneys, cartilage, smooth muscle cells in the arteries and veins, [the eyes](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9862591/), and the brain.  
> Zombie cells are aging cells that no longer function normally and don’t divide, but haven’t been cleared by the body (autophagy). They cause inflammation and can harm nearby healthy cells. Fisetin is the most effective substance at clearing zombie cells, which means that fisetin helps support healthy aging better than other natural compounds. This makes fisetin a very promising
>
> [longevity]()supplement.

### Fisetin for Healthy Cells  
[Fisetin improves cellular health](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S016643281100876X) by improving the function of cells and serving as an [antioxidant](https://thehealthyrd.com/healthy-thanksgiving-tips-to-boost-antioxidants/). This means that fisetin reduces aging and may support longevity and vitality.Fisetin is especially good at helping support healthy [mitochondria](https://thehealthyrd.com/mitochondria-diet-tips-for-energy/). The mitochondria is the energy producing part of the cell. Many fisetin reviews acknowledge that fisetin does indeed improve energy levels.
### Fisetin Benefits for the Heart  
[Fisetin helps artery function](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38062873/) according to early research. This natural antioxidant improves arterial function by reducing arterial stiffness. It may also increase nitric oxide availability and help [heart health](https://thehealthyrd.com/are-vitamins-good-for-the-heart/) by reducing free radicals.
